meta.name: understand-explain
meta.description: Use when you need a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入理解代码库中的任意文件或函数
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速理解不熟悉的代码模块
copy.tagline_en: Deep-dive into any file or function in the codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly understand unfamiliar code modules

howto.what: 当你指定一个代码文件、函数或模块后,Claude 会从项目的知识图谱中定位它,读取关联关系和源码文件,然后用通俗语言讲解它在架构中的角色、内部结构、和哪些部件相连、数据如何流入流出。
howto.when: 当你想深入理解某个具体文件、函数或模块时。Claude 会先检查项目是否已有知识图谱;没有的话,会提示你先运行 /understand,再接着讲解。

say.text: 帮我详细讲讲 login.ts 这个文件在项目里的作用
say.note: 会先用图谱定位该文件,再读源码梳理它的角色。

say.text: 解释一下函数 auth/login.ts:verifyToken 是怎么工作的
say.note: 按 路径:函数名 定位,给出逻辑及依赖/调用关系。

say.text: 这个模块属于架构的哪一层?它的上下游连接有哪些?
say.note: 基于图谱中的层和边回答。

howto.what_en: Claude locates a named file, function or module in the project's knowledge graph, follows its links and reads the source file, then explains in simple terms its architectural role, inner structure, related components, and data flow.
howto.when_en: Use this when you need a deep-dive explanation of one particular file, function, or module in the codebase. Claude first checks that the knowledge graph exists; if not, it asks you to run /understand first.

say_en.text: Explain in detail what login.ts does in this project.
say_en.note: It finds the file via the graph, then reads source and summarizes its role.

say_en.text: Walk me through how auth/login.ts:verifyToken works.
say_en.note: Path:function notation locates it; you get logic plus dependents.

say_en.text: Which architecture layer does this module belong to?
say_en.note: Answer draws on the layers and edges in the graph.
